'''2013 Worlds Day 2 Greg Shaw DS Wookiee Slaving Operation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Greg Shaw]] at [[2013 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Wookiee Slaving Operation / Indentured To The Empire]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
